levers.label: Tax revenue (% of GDP)
levers.help: Central government revenue target. Higher taxes fund services but depress investment, approval and growth; evasion rises with corruption.

levers.label: Spending (% of GDP)
levers.help: Total budget outside interest. Spending above revenue runs a deficit financed by debt.

levers.label: Average tariff
levers.help: Protects industry and raises revenue but raises import prices and invites retaliation.

levers.label: Central bank rate
levers.help: Higher rates cool inflation and borrowing; lower rates support growth and weaken the currency.

levers.label: Market regulation
levers.help: Raises consumer/worker protection and reduces inequality; too much slows productivity.

levers.label: Environmental regulation
levers.help: Cuts emissions and pollution; costs industry output in the short run.

levers.label: Clean-energy priority
levers.help: Steers utility investment towards low-carbon generation; reduces fossil import dependence over years.

levers.label: Immigration openness
levers.help: More workers and growth versus social tension, depending on public opinion.

levers.label: Press freedom
levers.help: Free media improves accountability and resilience to disinformation, but exposes the government.

levers.label: Security apparatus
levers.help: Raises counter-intelligence and capacity to repress unrest; erodes legitimacy long-term in open societies.

levers.label: Conscription level
levers.help: Larger manpower pool and reserves at economic and political cost.

budgetCategories.label: Healthcare
budgetCategories.help: Raises health index and epidemic resilience.

budgetCategories.label: Education
budgetCategories.help: Raises skills, research capacity and long-run productivity.

budgetCategories.label: Infrastructure
budgetCategories.help: Builds public capital: roads, rail, ports, grid; also supply capacity in war.

budgetCategories.label: Welfare
budgetCategories.help: Reduces poverty and inequality; supports consumption and stability.

budgetCategories.label: Administration & diplomacy
budgetCategories.help: State capacity: tax collection, corruption control, political capital, diplomacy and intelligence.

budgetCategories.label: Energy & food subsidies
budgetCategories.help: Shields households from price spikes; costly and distorts markets.
